title: Product catalog prototype scheme - stock extension

elements.name: Product Catalog
elements.expected_change: Add stock quantity display, stock field in create/edit form, and availability filter display state without replacing the existing catalog screen.

elements.name: Product Search and Category/Availability Filter
elements.expected_change: Extend the existing search/filter widget with an availability filter while preserving existing name/SKU search and category filter behavior.

elements.name: Create Product
elements.expected_change: Accept stock quantity in the existing create product form.

elements.name: Edit Product
elements.expected_change: Allow editing stock quantity in the existing edit product form.

elements.name: Product Service
elements.expected_change: Persist stock quantity and support availability filtering while preserving existing search/category/list behavior.

elements.name: Products API
elements.expected_change: Keep the existing /api/products resource and extend request/response/filter handling for stock_quantity and availability.

elements.name: Product
elements.expected_change: Extend existing product records with stock_quantity.

elements.name: Products JSON
elements.expected_change: Extend existing mock product records with stock_quantity.

notes: This scheme describes an incremental extension of the existing products-app prototype, not a greenfield product catalog.
The planner should prefer modify operations for existing product files from the previous run baseline. Create new files only if needed by the selected kit and file plan.
